# Magicstick Clean

> Locally owned, bilingual (English/French) residential and commercial cleaning company serving Clarence-Rockland, Ottawa and Gatineau (Ontario/Quebec, Canada). Free personalized quote with a same-day reply; the client then pays online by card or by Interac e-Transfer with their order number.

Contact: phone or text (343) 843-7761 · magicstickclean@gmail.com · https://magicstickclean.ca

Prices are not published: every job gets a free personalized quote (https://magicstickclean.ca/quote.html). First cleaning: 20% off (one per household). A standard cleaning can also be booked and paid directly online (https://magicstickclean.ca/book.html).

## Services

- [Standard cleaning (homes, condos, apartments)](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-standard-cleaning.html): regular home cleaning, one-time or weekly, biweekly, monthly.
- [Deep cleaning](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-deep-cleaning.html): inside fridge and oven, baseboards, door frames, vents, cabinet fronts, interior windows.
- [Move-in / move-out cleaning](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-move-in-move-out-cleaning.html): empty homes before or after a move, for tenants, owners and landlords.
- [Airbnb and short-term rental turnovers](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-airbnb-cleaning.html): cleaning between guests for hosts and property managers.
- [Office and commercial cleaning](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-office-cleaning.html): small offices and workplaces.
- [Retail and store cleaning](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-retail-cleaning.html): shops and storefronts.
- [Post-construction and event cleanup](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-post-construction-cleaning.html): dust and debris after renovations or events.
- [Windows, lawn and snow removal](https://magicstickclean.ca/service-outdoor-seasonal.html): window and glass cleaning, lawn and yard clearing, snow removal (by quote).
- [All services](https://magicstickclean.ca/services.html)

## Service areas

- [Clarence-Rockland](https://magicstickclean.ca/location-clarence-rockland.html): Rockland, Clarence Creek, Bourget, Hammond, Cheney, Clarence Point and surroundings (home base).
- [Ottawa](https://magicstickclean.ca/location-ottawa.html): including Orléans, Cumberland, Navan, Gloucester and central Ottawa.
- [Gatineau](https://magicstickclean.ca/location-gatineau.html): Gatineau, Hull, Aylmer and surroundings (Quebec).
- [All service areas](https://magicstickclean.ca/locations.html)

## Getting a quote or booking

- [Free quote](https://magicstickclean.ca/quote.html): short form, no payment, same-day reply.
- [Book a standard cleaning online](https://magicstickclean.ca/book.html): choose the day, time window, hours and frequency.
- [Gift cards](https://magicstickclean.ca/gift-cards.html): bought and paid by card online, emailed automatically with a unique code; never expire.
- [Careers](https://magicstickclean.ca/careers.html): join the cleaning team.
